MATLAB 程序：exe608.m

w = 0.1:1:1000;

G = tf(250, [conv([1, 0], conv([0.1, 1], [0.01, 1]))]);

% 待校正系统的开环传递函数

% 滞后-超前校正系统的传递函数

Gc = tf($conv([0.1, 1], [1/0.93, 1])$, $conv([7.35/0.93, 1], [1/73.5, 1])$);

G1 = series(G, Gc); % 已校正系统的开环传递函数

[x, y] = bd_asymp(G, w); [xc, yc] = bd_asymp(Gc, w);

[x1, y1] = bd_asymp(G1, w);

figure(1);

semilogx(x, y, 'r'); hold on;

semilogx(xc, yc, 'b');

semilogx(x1, y1, 'k');

grid; hold off

figure(2); margin(G1); grid

G11 = feedback(G1,1);

figure(3); step(G11); grid
